name: frontend
//dev: Pinned to 3310. `next dev` silently walks to the next free port when its own is taken, which leaves the browser on a URL served by the wrong app — so the port is fixed rather than negotiated. It was 3300 until another project on this machine took that; 3200 is the marketing site. If 3310 is ever taken too, move it again and change it here, not on the command line.

scripts.//prebuild: @app/shared resolves to its compiled dist/, which is gitignored. A fresh clone (Vercel) has no dist/ until this runs, and every import of it fails as module-not-found.
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.cap:android: npm run cap:sync && npx cap open android

//typecheck: typedRoutes derives its Route union from the app directory into .next/types, and tsc cannot see a route added since the last build. Running typegen first is what stops a clean checkout failing on links that are perfectly valid.
